svg.title: AD-E-08 گارانتی و تعمیر و نتیجه 600
svg.desc: Persian RTL low-fidelity design evidence. Requested->under_review->approved->received->repairing; resolve received/repairing, close resolved only. Refund/replacement needs positive quantity within delivered quantity; refund positive integer Toman capped by line value, non-refund amount forbidden. Resolve and close require Step-Up; both require resolution_note. Refund/replacement references are requests. Server permission and lifecycle remain authoritative. Design evidence grants no permission and certifies no runtime readiness. Keyboard and state behavior are specified in companion documentation; this SVG is not an interactive implementation.

g.text: نتیجهٔ گارانتی با بستن پرونده جداست؛ بستن پرونده تأیید
اطلاعات فقط از پاسخ مجاز؛ شمارش خارج از دسترسی نمایش داده
شناسه، وضعیت و زمان دریافت پاسخ کنار هم دیده شوند.
